title: agropyron cristatiforme
intro: Agropyron cristatiforme, commonly known as Crested Wheat Grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Crested Wheat Grass include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
